Ringwriter

Motion·by @edo_lunardi·2026-08-29·inspora page·original post

What it is

Ringwriter: black canvas filled with concentric rings of tiny monospace text ('THE CONTENT ARCHITECTURE...' repeated), each ring rotating at its own speed like vinyl grooves - kinetic typographic artwork.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Dense concentric text rings around a center point; characters set along circular paths, size and tracking vary per ring; rings rotate continuously at different angular velocities (inner faster, outer slower), creating a moire of moving type. A small white cursor dash sits at one ring. Ambient infinite loop, occasional density pulses as rings phase-align.

Build prompt

Build a ringwriter kinetic-type piece. Canvas or SVG on near-black (#0D0D0D). Choose a phrase ('THE CONTENT ARCHITECTURE ') and repeat it along concentric circles: ring i has radius r_i = r0 + i*pitch (pitch ~14px), font size ~9-11px monospace, fill white at 55-80% opacity varying per ring. Lay characters along the circle (per-character rotate + translate, or SVG textPath). Rotate each ring continuously: angular velocity omega_i = base/(i+1) so inner rings spin faster; alternate direction every 3rd ring for interference. Keep a small white rectangular cursor tick parked on one ring, blinking 1Hz. Density pulse: every ~8s briefly ease all opacities +20% as the rings phase-align. Reduced motion: static rings. Performance: pre-render each ring to an offscreen canvas and only rotate composites.
